lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple vertical columns of high-luminance circular nodes situated posterior to the gill slits. The primary visible cluster consists of roughly three vertical rows of 4-6 spots each, forming a structured grid pattern in the mid-lateral region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are visible intersecting with the larger white blobs, most prominently in the mid-flank area posterior to the pectoral fin attachment.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible running along the flank. Each ridge is defined by a sharp vertical luminance gradient, characterized by high-intensity highlights on the upper margin and narrow shadow cast immediately below.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced transition in spot morphology from high-density, small, irregular micro-blobs on the rostrum to larger, more widely spaced, circular nodes on the lateral flank.
